documents.title: Lending pool exploit - initial findings
documents.reliability_rationale: Rubric: named security publisher, first-hand monitoring claim, no attribution.
documents.text: SYNTHETIC INCIDENT REPORT (test data). Our monitoring observed a protocol exploit at 02:14 UTC on 1 Oct 2026. The attacker wallet 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000a000 drained the lending pool. Stolen funds were forwarded to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000a001 within minutes. A second hop sent part of the stolen funds to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000a005. Funds later reached 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000a006, which we consider part of the exploit flow. We have not attributed the activity to any person or organisation.

documents.title: Tracking: exploit transactions
documents.reliability_rationale: Rubric: community issue tracker; unverified contributor claims.
documents.text: Tracking issue for the exploit. Transaction 0x48b896ce37328d3083bdd36928e7b959aa01c22fe86189a2d054e52a03c19c89 moved stolen funds onward. One recipient looks like 0x0000…a003 in the explorer screenshot. Someone else posted 0x0000…001 but that shortened form is unclear. Contributor pasted 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000A002 as another relay of the exploit.
